title: batch-crop-images
subtitle: Batch Image Cropping Tool
description: Draw a crop box once and it is applied to a whole folder of similar images. Written because I refused to crop them one by one, and apparently other people refused too.
longDescription: An efficient batch image processing tool that provides an intuitive interface for cropping multiple similar images simultaneously. This tool streamlines the workflow for processing large sets of images with consistent cropping requirements.
features: Draw one crop box in an OpenCV window
Apply the same box across a folder
results: Interactive or headless batch cropping with a pip-installable CLI
